# String Scoring Utilities

## Overview
Pure Swift `String` extension utilities providing normalization and fuzzy scoring primitives used by the app-scheme search pipeline.

## Interface
- `String.normalizedForScoring` — Public normalized-lowercase value used as the scoring comparison basis ([`String+NormalizedForScoring.swift:String.normalizedForScoring`]).
- `String.score(word:fuzziness:)` — Public fuzzy scoring method returning a `Double` relevance score ([`String+Score.swift:String.score`]).

## Invariants
- Scoring is deterministic and side-effect free: identical inputs always produce identical scores without hidden state.
- When the optional `fuzziness` parameter is `nil`, the scoring routine requires an exact character-by-character match and returns a score of zero when a character is not found.

## Side Effects
- None. The extensions perform pure computation on immutable value types and do not mutate state, perform I/O, or make network calls.

## Verification
- Run: `swift build`
